title: The best MSFS Keyboard setup for flight stick & yoke pilots
description:
Struggling with accidental gear drops or hunting 2mm cockpit dials with your mouse while holding your flight stick? In this video, we wipe out conflicting default bindings and turn your keyboard into an ergonomic, high-speed secondary systems deck built specifically to complement your physical joystick or yoke.

Whether you fly MSFS 2024 or MSFS 2020, default keyboard profiles are loaded with dangerous flight surface triggers that can ruin a multi-hour flight with a single desk bump. If you already have pitch, roll, and throttle mapped to hardware, this step-by-step tutorial walks you through creating a clean companion profile for rapid custom cameras, rotary autopilot stepping, IFR radio swaps, and zero-risk pausing.

⏱️ Video Chapters:
00:00 - Intro: Why Default Keyboards Ruin Flights
00:44 - The Blank Canvas & Camera Grid Setup
09:04 - Autopilot Value Stepping (Heading, Alt, VS)
14:14 - The IFR Fast-Track (Baro, Comms & ATC)
19:34 - Sim Rate & The Active Pause Reality

Recommended Companion Keyboard Layout:
• Cockpit Camera Snaps: Map "Save Custom Camera 0-9" to Ctrl + Alt + NumPad (0-9) and "Load Custom Camera" to bare NumPad (0-9) for instantaneous, 1-touch instrument views (FMC, Overhead, PFD, EICAS, Autopilot).
• Autopilot Heading Bug: Decrease [ | Increase ] | Sync Current Heading: \
• Autopilot Altitude: Decrease ; | Increase ' (Single Quote)
• Vertical Speed: Decrease . (Period) | Increase / (Slash)
• Altimeter / Baro: STD 29.92 toggle mapped to Shift + B | Kohlsman manual pressure dial mapped to Page Up / Page Down.
• COM Radios & ATC: COM1 Standby Swap mapped to Ctrl + 1 | ATC Dialog choices 0–9 mapped to Top-Row Number keys.
• Sim Rate & Safety Pause: Sim Rate Activate (R) with +/- adjustment; use ESC instead of Active Pause to prevent pitch-trim runaways and stall dives.

✈️ Hardware & Platform:
• Simulators: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 / Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020
• Setup Profile: Keyboard as Secondary Companion Deck alongside Joystick, HOTAS, or Flight Yoke
